product.name: Japam
product.subtitle: Digital Mantra Practice
product.oneLiner: A Candy Crush–style match-3 PWA where every match plays deity mantra audio and counts toward your japa (mantra repetition) goals.
product.elevatorPitch: Japam turns Hindu mantra japa into an engaging mobile game: match deity-colored gems, hear authentic mantras, track lifetime counts, join temple marathons and collective Maha Japa Yagnas, and practice in 23+ Indian languages—all without replacing temple worship.

linkedinCopySuggestions.companyTagline: Match divine gems. Hear mantras. Build your japa.
linkedinCopySuggestions.aboutShort: Japam (japam.digital) is India's digital mantra practice platform—a match-3 game where every match chants deity mantras, tracks your japa, and connects you to temple marathons and collective Maha Japa Yagnas. 22 deities, 1000 levels, 23 languages, installable PWA.
linkedinCopySuggestions.aboutLong: Japam reimagines Hindu japa for the smartphone era without replacing temple tradition. Players match deity-colored gems in a Candy Crush–style board; each match plays authentic mantra audio and adds to lifetime japa counts. Beyond solo play, Japam links devotees to real temples: priests run Japa Marathons by location, and Maha Japa Yagnas unite thousands toward shared chanting goals. Special modes include Pushpa Aradhana (digital flower offering), 108-japa sessions, and weekly streak plans. Pro members unlock the full level map, marathons, and the Apavarga community for priest chat and appointments. Built as a fast, installable PWA with 23 Indian languages, Cashfree payments, and cloud save via Google Sign-In. From AI Developer India.
